# Nazor.Themes.Fluent

Add a package reference to `Nazor.Themes.Fluent`. Register its private icon fonts before building the application; select the theme separately.

```csharp
using Nazor.Themes.Fluent;

builder.Fonts.AddFluentFonts();
// Build the application, then select its appearance.
app.Appearance.Theme = Nazor.Themes.Fluent.Themes.Fluent;
```

Fluent layers its WinUI palette, control styles and motion over Basic. It follows the application's light, dark, forced-color and reduced-motion preferences. It prefers Segoe UI Variable, then Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI and installed sans-serif fallbacks. Matching preserves the variable font's weight and optical-size axes. This follows the [Windows typography guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/apps/design/signature-experiences/typography) for supported scripts; it does not reproduce every language-specific XamlAutoFontFamily mapping or certify identical DirectWrite rasterization.

Control states and metrics follow the WinUI 3 templates:

- A checked `ToggleButton` uses the accent fill. Disabled buttons and fields keep the ordinary control hairline, and disabled accent fills have no border.
- `Slider` has a 4px rail and a 20px thumb. Its accent core is 12px at rest, 14px under the pointer and 10px while pressed. `RadioButton` uses the same 12/14/10px glyph sizes. The `Switch` knob stretches to 17 × 14 while pressed.
- `ProgressBar` draws a 3px indicator over a centered 1px track in every size.
- Selected list, tree and option rows show a centered 3 × 16 accent pill on the leading edge.
- `Select` keeps its neutral frame when expanded; keyboard focus retains the separate focus ring.
- `TextField` and `SearchField` clear actions use a centered 12px dismiss X with native-preferred symbols and a packaged fallback.
- Classic `TimePicker` columns and lists use inset, spaced 32px rows with the same accent selection pill as choice lists.
- List/Tree rows use neutral selected/hover/pressed fills with explicit disabled and keyboard-focus states. Grid tiles use an accent selection border; collection checks are 20px. Automatic row metrics are 40px for ListView and 28px for TreeView. Retained rows relocate over 250ms; Tree chevrons rotate over 167ms. These are source-informed portable styles, not a claim of the full native collection drag/presenter API.
- In-page surfaces such as cards, expanders, group boxes and lists use the 4px control radius. Windows, flyouts and dialogs keep the 8px overlay radius. `Expander` has a 48px header and a 16px panel padding.
- Dialogs place their content on an opaque `LayerFillColorAlt` area and their footer on the base fill, with 24px padding. Titles use the 20px semibold subtitle style.
- The month calendar uses 40px days with 1px margins, a left title with trailing vertical navigation and localized shortest weekday names. Selection is outlined; Today is filled, with distinct hover, press, focus and disabled states. The picker popup has one rounded calendar edge.
- Tooltips use 12/16px caption text.
- Caption buttons use the subtle hover and pressed fills.
- Overlays use the two-layer Fluent shadow, which is stronger in the dark scheme.
- Headings follow the WinUI type ramp in semibold. Controls keep the natural line height of the font.

`DatePickerButton` selects the covered native Calendar glyph or the packaged `FluentSymbol.CalendarLtr20Regular` alternative at 12px in a 32px trailing area. Register the private fonts with `AddFluentFonts()` for the portable path. The field remains editable and keeps its existing parsing behavior.

Search, calendar, password reveal, document-tab and message-box icon parts select equivalent family/glyph pairs: Segoe Fluent Icons, then Segoe MDL2 Assets, then packaged Fluent System Icons. Every choice requires the actual provider to match the exact family and cover the complete glyph. Missing all candidates leaves the icon area empty. `UseSystemFonts = false` excludes system discovery while allowing explicitly registered private fonts. No Segoe font is copied or redistributed.

`Nazor.Themes.Fluent.StyleSheets.Fluent` exposes the Fluent rules alone. `Icon.Symbol` accepts `FluentSymbol` values such as `FluentSymbol.Add20Regular` and `FluentSymbol.Star20Filled`. They select the packaged font independently of the active theme. The package copies both TTFs and license notices to `Themes/Fluent` in application output and publish directories. No system icon font installation is required. These icon fonts do not supply interface text fonts.

The fonts are redistributed unmodified from Microsoft's [Fluent UI System Icons](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/tree/9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774/fonts) under its MIT license; retain the packaged `LICENSE.txt`, `NOTICE.txt` and `SOURCE.txt` with the fonts. See [icon usage](../Guide/22-Images-Icons-and-Drawing.md#svg-and-icon-fonts).

The proprietary Segoe Fluent Icons and Segoe MDL2 Assets fonts are not included; their mappings must not be used with the packaged Fluent System Icons fonts. The built-in `CaptionButtons` draw their shapes on every platform.

### `WinUISymbol`

Namespace `Nazor.Themes.Fluent`. [Source](../../Sources/Themes/Nazor.Themes.Fluent/WinUISymbol.cs)

A bounded native-preferred semantic catalog. `FluentSymbol` remains the fixed packaged catalog. These alternatives have equivalent meanings and different artwork; no cross-platform pixel equivalence is implied. Use `AddFluentFonts()` even on Windows to provide the final portable alternative. Resolution follows `IFontSymbol.Fallbacks`; no operating-system check or global font state is used. Segoe font licenses are not bundled or extended by this package.

| Declaration | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| `public readonly struct WinUISymbol : IFontSymbol` | Native-preferred semantic icon with explicit portable alternative. |
| `public WinUISymbol()` | Empty default; invalid as an active icon. |
| `public string FontFamily { get; }` | Segoe Fluent Icons, or empty for the default. |
| `public string Glyph { get; }` | Preferred native Unicode glyph, or empty for the default. |
| `public IReadOnlyList<IFontSymbol> Fallbacks { get; }` | Segoe MDL2 Assets and packaged Fluent System Icons, in order. |
| `public static WinUISymbol Search { get; }` | Native U+E721; portable Search16Regular. |

### `FluentSymbol`

Namespace `Nazor.Themes.Fluent`. [Source](../../Sources/Themes/Nazor.Themes.Fluent/FluentSymbol.cs)

Members are generated from Fluent UI System Icons 1.1.345, commit `9eb184e96268d3293462f9d9d19225b4c7b07774`. Names contain the design size and variant, followed by a locale suffix where supplied upstream. Sizes identify the source artwork; NSS controls the displayed size. Regular and Filled have independent mappings. The default struct value is empty and cannot be used as an active symbol.

## Content and collection motion

Fluent styles `ContentTransitionLayer`/`FrameTransitionLayer` for entrance, directional slide and drill requests, and `CalendarTransitionLayer` for separate incoming/outgoing zoom. The calendar header remains mounted while its fade replays. `LayoutTransition` and `ItemsTransitionItem` use measured transform relocation; collection content has separate entrance/removal motion. Base `overlay-exit-duration` controls outgoing lifetime, while each layer's NSS controls its visual timeline. Reduced motion applies final states and removes exits immediately. [Shared contracts](../Guide/23-Transitions-and-Animations.md#content-and-layout-motion)

Centered `DialogSize.Auto` dialogs measure content within 320â€“548 by 184â€“756 logical units and a 24-unit window inset. Primary/Destructive, Secondary and Cancel actions follow that order at 8-unit gaps; automatic actions share width except Help. Dialog entry/exit uses separate 250/167ms scale and 83ms opacity tracks with retained exit and reduced-motion support. See [dialog policy and migration](../Guide/13-Windows-and-Dialogs.md#window-local-dialogs) and [motion](../Guide/23-Transitions-and-Animations.md). These resource-derived values await measurement against the installed WinUI Gallery.

## Disclosure motion

Fluent keeps the measured Expander/Accordion panel clip at its full natural height while content translates. Entry uses 333ms; exit movement uses 167ms, with retained close phases of 167ms Down and 200ms Up. The stable chevron rotates with state. Measured first-open arming avoids a flash; reversals sample the current transform. `KeepMounted` preserves the same noninteractive closed subtree; reduced motion releases the clip immediately. [Shared disclosure contract](../Guide/23-Transitions-and-Animations.md#measured-disclosure-motion)

## Navigation and document tabs

Fluent distinguishes navigation indicators from document sheets. Navigation uses transparent selection and a three-unit indicator with measured 250ms travel. Document headers use 32-unit rows above a sheet, 100–240 equal-width limits, 16-unit leading content, 32×24 close/add actions and packaged Add12/Dismiss12 glyphs. Compact hides unselected visual labels while preserving names. Light/dark and forced colors share the same semantic structure. Reduced motion resolves through the shared engine.

These dimensions are informed by upstream WinUI TabView resource/template sources. Four-unit concave sheet wings are rendered using theme gradients. This is not an installed WinUiGallery parity certification: native side-by-side capture and font/optical acceptance remain separate checks. Navigation/Pivot styling is a theme candidate until native timing/geometry measurement is available. [Portable behavior](../Guide/12-Navigation.md#section-and-document-tabs)

PipsPager supplies a finite bounded dot selector with source-informed WinUI target/dot metrics. Button states use strong-fill foregrounds, transparent backgrounds and inner focus treatment. Native glyph optical rendering and installed comparison remain separate acceptance checks; behavior and selection are shared across themes.

| `public static FluentSymbol ResizeSmall 16Filled { get; }` | Filled icon, glyph `\uEA20`. |

ProgressRing geometry follows the generated upstream Lottie source: determinate radius 44.25%/stroke 8.296875%, indeterminate radius 43.75%/stroke 9.375%. The normal track is transparent. Medium is 32 logical units, Small 16 and the Nazor Large step 64. Determinate presentation increases at 2s per fraction and decreases immediately, with the source endpoint trim keys. Indeterminate motion rotates 900 degrees over 2s and grows/shrinks a half-circle. These are source-derived candidates; the unused ProgressRingStrokeThickness resource value 4 does not describe the generated geometry. Installed-build silhouettes, rasterization and motion capture remain separate parity checks. [Numeric presentation](../Guide/23-Transitions-and-Animations.md#numeric-presentation)

## Overlay family motion

Menus/popovers use resolved-side 50-unit travel; selects retain directional clip entry; tooltips fade without moving; drawers enter/exit at their configured edge with a separate scrim. Retained exits reject actions and accessibility activation, while modal barriers stay until release. Reopening retargets current values and reduced motion removes retention immediately. [Family timing and verification limits](../Guide/23-Transitions-and-Animations.md#fluent-overlay-family-motion)

The flyout direction/distance and tooltip fade behavior are informed by upstream WinUI source. Candidate durations are not installed WinUiGallery parity measurements. TeachingTip, ContentDialog and segmented-picker motion remain their own treatments.

ColorPicker follows the source-informed default [WinUI template](https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml/blob/main/controls/dev/ColorPicker/ColorPicker.xaml) arrangement: 312px width, 256px rectangular spectrum with 44px side preview, 12px slider tracks and 120px channel fields with trailing labels. It composes the shared six-plane HSV behavior and keeps CSS #rrggbbaa input order. Native circular/constrained spectra and More disclosure are separate capability gaps; this portable composition does not certify full native ColorPicker API or pixel equivalence.

## Adaptive navigation

NavigationView uses source-informed Fluent compact48, Top48/content Header52, toggle40×36, left row36 with4 units of vertical spacing, icon16 and selection markers3×16/16×3. Selected, hovered, pressed and disabled fills use existing Fluent tokens. Measured indicators use the shared transition engine and honor reduced motion. Within NavigationView, tree rows retain color/corner transitions while the shared marker owns positional motion; this avoids measuring an intermediate row-reposition transform during automatic row-metric changes. The toggle resolves native Segoe U+E700 when available and packaged Navigation20Regular U+F560 otherwise. The source also uses an AnimatedGlobalNavigationButtonVisualSource; the portable toggle currently implements its static fallback, not that animated asset.

The portable control keeps Top roots horizontally reachable, rather than claiming the entire native overflow/search/settings/back API. Geometry and timing remain subject to installed native/optical/accessibility acceptance. [Navigation behavior](../Guide/12-Navigation.md#adaptive-application-navigation)
